records.text: Candace Owens said Airbnb co-founder Joe Gebbia gave $3.1 million against Mamdani.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The Airbnb co-founder, Joe Gebbia, gave $3.1 million. It didn't matter.

verification.notes: Public-filing-based reporting published by election day supports $3 million from Joe Gebbia to three pro-Cuomo or anti-Mamdani groups. Aggregated contribution records show cumulative New York giving above that amount, including a separate $100,000 contribution, but the reviewed sources do not directly establish that exactly $3.1 million had been given to stop Mamdani at the time of the episode. The donor, purpose, and approximate scale are supported; the exact figure remains only partly supported.
